description.en:
Lifts every Special Move ban set with CMND_BTL_SET_SKILL_BAN at once (all 64 entries of the ban list).
No shipped script calls it: btl0004.nut lifts its bans one by one with SET_SKILL_BAN(false, ...).

examples.case: Lifting all bans at a scripted beat (not found in script_clean/; invented)
